draft.emotion: nostalgic and warm, looking back at something from long ago
notes: Takes an umlaut in the comparative ('älter') and superlative ('am ältesten').
Before a noun, 'alt' can also mean 'former' or 'long-standing' (e.g., 'meine alte Schule' = my former school; 'ein alter Freund' = an old friend).

senses.definition: Having lived or existed for a long time; not young or new.
